# Turn ideas into motion.

Launch videos, demos, tutorials, and social clips, made on your Mac by Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok.

Free during early access.

## Made, not generated.

Every video is built scene by scene on a real timeline. And when it's done, you can still open it up and change anything.

### Launch videos

Point it at your repo. The agent reads your product, design system, and copy, then cuts a launch video in your brand.

### Assets to video

Drop in screenshots, clips, logos, and audio, tag them in the prompt, and the agent times and animates them on the timeline.

### Motion graphics

Text, shapes, charts, and transitions, animated in code with real springs. The agent checks every frame before you see it.

### Short-form

9:16, styled captions, cuts on the beat. Post it to TikTok, Reels, or Shorts the same hour.

## You already pay for a film studio.

EndFrame puts Claude, ChatGPT, and Grok to work on your Mac. If you pay for any one of them, that's all EndFrame needs. No API keys.

### Describe the video

One prompt in the composer. Tag your assets, pick a style, or point it at your repo.

### The agent builds it

It writes real scenes on a real timeline, renders frames of its own work, and fixes what looks wrong.

### Edit anything, then export

Scrub, trim, go back to any version, adjust any detail. Export in 1080p or 4K, rendered on your Mac.

## It reviews its own work.

After every edit, the agent renders real frames and looks at them. It measures margins, checks text contrast, and runs a 33-rule quality gate. If something is off, it fixes it before you see it.

- shot-scene-blank 9 frames, none blank ✓

- shot-text-contrast Lc 62 ≥ 45 ✓

- shot-edge-bleed margins clear ✓

## Six things you'll use every day.

Built the way a video tool should feel: fast, hands-on, and easy to undo.

### Tag anything into the prompt

Drop images, clips, and audio into the composer as chips, along with skills and connectors. The agent sees exactly what you see.

### Capture the frame, fix the frame

Stop on the frame that's wrong, capture it, and say what's off. The agent gets the exact pixels. No screenshots, no long explanations.

### A timeline you can feel

Hover to scrub, instantly. Trim, reorder, and delete clips without breaking anything the agent made.

### Every version, one click back

Every edit, yours or the agent's, becomes a version you can return to. Preview any point in time and restore it without worry.

### Your look, saved

Turn any project's style into a reusable template: colors, type, motion, and a real rendered preview.

### Export in one click

1080p or 4K, rendered on your Mac. The preview and the export share one engine, so what you see is exactly what ships.

## Everything else is one connector away.

Voiceover from ElevenLabs. Footage from Runway, Higgsfield, or fal.ai. Designs from Canva, copy from Notion. One prompt can carry a video from start to finish.

Fifteen one-click connectors, or add any MCP server with a URL, a command, or a config file.

Download EndFrame, sign in, and make your first video tonight. Early access is open to everyone, no waitlist.
